battle.name: 第五次中東戰爭
battle.brief: 中文維基戰爭列表所列的第五次中東戰爭於1982年6月爆發，戰事主要在黎巴嫩境內展開，以色列陸軍投入Merkava Mark 1主戰坦克，在南部戰線執行裝甲突破、據點攻擊與火力支援，並與步兵及裝甲車協同作戰，承擔核心重裝甲任務。

kit.name: 梅卡瓦主戰坦克
kit.history: 梅卡瓦主戰坦克是以色列陸軍當時的核心裝甲載具，負責正面突破與裝甲防衛，並可和步兵、裝甲車及炮兵協同，構成地面部隊的主要坦克火力。

countries: 本戰不能簡化成以色列對黎巴嫩國家軍的整體戰爭。直接主要交戰者是以色列與巴勒斯坦解放組織（PLO）率領、駐紮黎巴嫩的武裝；其中法塔赫等派系保有旅級部隊，另有黎巴嫩人武裝及南方黎巴嫩軍（SLA）相關部隊作戰。黎巴嫩政府與黎巴嫩軍隊沒有形成一致的對以作戰命令，部分單位維持中立或選擇與不同派系合作，因此阿方不能視為一個由黎巴嫩國家軍統一指揮的戰區。敘利亞沒有投入大規模地面部隊對以色列作戰，但敘利亞空軍與地空飛彈部隊在貝卡谷地直接迎戰以軍。美國和法國不是交戰方，而是推動停火、協助安排撤離的外交一方；聯合國安全理事會則透過第501號與第502號決議要求克制、停火及撤軍。區分國家、國家軍、非國家武裝與外交行為體，是理解這場戰爭的前提。
countriesEn: This war cannot be reduced to a single Israeli war against the conventional army of the Lebanese state. The principal direct belligerent opposite Israel was the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO), whose Palestine and Lebanese formations were deployed across southern Lebanon. Fatah and other PLO factions maintained brigade-sized units, while Lebanese armed groups and units associated with the South Lebanon Army also fought. The Lebanese government and armed forces did not issue a single coherent command for war against Israel; some units remained neutral or cooperated with different factions. The Arab side therefore was not one national army operating under one Lebanese chain of command. Syria did not commit large ground forces to the fight against Israel, but its air force and surface-to-air missile forces engaged Israeli aircraft directly in the Bekaa Valley. The United States and France were not belligerents and acted diplomatically to seek a ceasefire and organize the evacuation. The UN Security Council demanded restraint, cessation of hostilities, and withdrawal through Resolutions 501 and 502. Distinguishing the state, its army, non-state militias, and diplomatic actors is essential to understanding the campaign.
people: 關鍵決策分屬政治、軍事與外交幾個中心。以色列總理梅納赫姆·貝京批准戰役升級，國防部長阿里爾·沙龍主張把打擊範圍推向黎巴嫩深處；總參謀長拉斐爾·艾坦主持作戰計畫與參謀協調，南部戰區則由阿維多爾·本-加利指揮，第八裝甲師等部隊在其作戰序列內負責沿海攻勢。艾坦在七月底任期屆滿，由丹·肖蒙接任總參謀長。PLO主席亞西爾·阿拉法特在貝魯特主持政治層面的停火與撤離決策，各旅仍由前線軍事指揮官執行作戰。黎巴嫩總統伊利亞斯·薩基斯與總理沙菲克·瓦贊試圖讓黎巴嫩軍隊避開以色列與PLO之間的全面戰鬥，但可運用的指揮權有限。敘利亞總統哈菲茲·阿薩德控制貝卡谷地的空軍與防空部署；敘利亞防空軍負責人納吉·賈米爾在六月初的空襲中陣亡，使指揮體系受到直接衝擊。美國總統羅納德·雷根於六月十一日提出停火框架，菲利普·哈比卜則在圍堵階段協助達成PLO撤出貝魯特的安排。
peopleEn: Major decisions came from several political, military, and diplomatic centers. Israeli Prime Minister Menachem Begin authorized the escalation, Defense Minister Ariel Sharon pressed for a deeper campaign inside Lebanon, and Chief of Staff Rafael Eitan directed the operational planning and staff coordination. Avigdor Ben-Gal commanded the southern front, within whose order of battle the Eighth Armored Division and other formations carried out the coastal advance. Eitan completed his term at the end of July and was succeeded as chief of staff by Dan Shomron. PLO chairman Yasser Arafat handled the political-level ceasefire and evacuation decisions from Beirut, while field commanders continued to command their brigades. Lebanese President Elias Sarkis and Prime Minister Shafik Wazzan tried to keep the Lebanese army out of the full Israeli-PLO conflict, although their effective authority was limited. Syrian president Hafez al-Assad controlled the deployment of Syrian air and air-defence forces in the Bekaa. Naji Jamil, the head of the Syrian air-defence force, was killed in an air attack in early June, directly disrupting the command structure. US president Ronald Reagan presented a ceasefire framework on 11 June, and Philip Habib later helped negotiate the PLO evacuation from Beirut.
kits: 以色列的地面作戰核心是M48A3、M60A1與少量Centurion及M24 Chieftain戰車，步兵則由M151 M2半履帶車和机械化步兵承載。砲兵主力包括M109A1 155公厘自走砲與M107 203公厘自走砲，基層火力使用105公厘穿甲彈或高爆彈、120公厘迫擊炮炸彈，以及155與203公厘高爆榴彈。前沿部隊先由工兵利用既有橋梁或建立臨時渡河點，砲彈再由後方裝載站送至各師、旅所屬陣地；沿海公路在首週打通後，燃料、備件與前線補給車隊得以持續北進。空中武器包括F-4E Phantom II、A-4F Skyhawk、F-15、AH-1S Cobra、UH-1H Iroquois與E-2C Hawkeye，C-130和Arava則負責較大噸位的運輸。海軍以Sa'ar 5型飛彈艇配合早期型加百列反艦飛彈，執行沿岸監視、封鎖與火力支援。PLO序列中可見T-55戰車、BMP-1裝甲步兵車、BTR-50或BTR-60裝甲車、RPG-7火箭筒、ZU-23雙聯高射砲及BM-13系列122公厘火箭發射車，火炮包括D-30 122公厘牽引砲與M-46 130公厘榴彈砲。敘利亞在貝卡部署SA-2及SA-3地空飛彈與MiG-21、MiG-23等戰機。PLO的燃料、維修件與備份砲彈分散在南部陣地及通往貝卡的補給線，以軍控制沿海道路後，其遠距補給須承受更長的內陸運輸線。
kitsEn: The core of Israel's ground force consisted of M48A3, M60A1, and smaller numbers of Centurion and M24 Chieftain tanks, with infantry carried in M151 M2 half-tracks and mechanized formations. The artillery main arm comprised M109A1 155 mm self-propelled howitzers and M107 203 mm self-propelled howitzers. Lower-level fire support used 105 mm high-explosive or anti-tank rounds, 120 mm mortar bombs, and 155 mm and 203 mm high-explosive shells. Combat engineers opened river crossings by using existing bridges or constructing temporary crossings, after which ammunition moved from rear loading points to brigade and divisional gun positions. Once the coastal road was opened in the first week, daily truck convoys carried fuel, spare parts, and ammunition northward. The air arm included F-4E Phantom II, A-4F Skyhawk, F-15, AH-1S Cobra, UH-1H Iroquois, and E-2C Hawkeye aircraft, while C-130 and Arava transports handled heavier loads. The navy employed Sa'ar 5-class missile boats with early Gabriel anti-ship missiles for coastal surveillance, interdiction, and fire support. Equipment identified in PLO formations included T-55 tanks, BMP-1 infantry fighting vehicles, BTR-50 or BTR-60 armored carriers, RPG-7 launchers, ZU-23 twin anti-aircraft guns, and BM-13-series 122 mm rocket launchers. PLO artillery included D-30 122 mm towed guns and M-46 130 mm howitzers. Syria deployed SA-2 and SA-3 surface-to-air missiles and MiG-21 and MiG-23 fighters in the Bekaa. PLO fuel, spare parts, and ammunition were dispersed among southern positions and supply routes toward the Bekaa; after Israel secured the coastal road, longer inland routes had to absorb the additional burden.
tactics: 六月六日清晨，以色列先以炮兵和航空兵同時壓制PLO前沿與指揮節點，再由裝甲旅沿三個方向推進，刻意利用快速運動切斷道路、渡口和後方聯絡，而不是逐村掃過所有據點。南部由拿古拉出發，經Jisr al-Majamiyeh橋、以方所稱的Quantarrah，向西頓與泰爾推進；中部由第九步兵師等部隊通過利塔尼河，向哈斯巴亞及貝卡南部伸展；北部部隊則進入舒夫地區，再向西轉進，與沿海戰線會合。裝甲部隊超越仍可運作的地段後，工兵迅速架設渡河設施，步兵和半履帶車清除被繞過的堡壘；M109與M107砲兵在師、旅後方形成可移動支援。PLO以反戰車壕、縱深陣地、坦克射界和分散火箭炮台阻止裝甲兵連續前進，步兵在局部路段進行短時間反擊並在受壓後撤往下一道陣地。貝卡空戰中，以軍以E-2C、雷達干擾車、AGM-45反輻射飛彈與同步航空攻擊處理SA-2及SA-3，先削弱雷達和發射陣地，再讓固定翼戰機低空進入；敘利亞戰機初期分散停留地面，待干擾與防空火力降低後才恢復出擊。進入貝魯特外圍後，以軍封鎖主要道路並逐個處理外圍陣地，沒有立即對整座市區展開地面總攻，而是以封鎖、砲火及談判迫使PLO指揮部選擇撤離。
tacticsEn: Early on 6 June, Israeli artillery and aircraft suppressed PLO forward positions and command nodes before armored brigades advanced on three axes. The intention was to move rapidly across roads, bridges, and rear communications rather than clear every settlement in sequence. In the south, forces left Naqoura, crossed the Litani area at Jisr al-Majamiyeh, known to the Israeli forces as Quantarrah, and drove toward Sidon and Tyre. In the center, formations including the Ninth Infantry Division crossed the Litani and extended toward Hasbaya and southern Bekaa. Northern forces entered the Chouf and then turned west to link with the coastal axis. After armored columns bypassed positions that remained operational, engineers opened crossings at once, and infantry in half-tracks eliminated bypassed strongpoints. M109 and M107 artillery batteries formed mobile support at division and brigade level. PLO troops slowed the armored advance with anti-tank ditches, depth-oriented positions, tank firing lanes, and dispersed rocket launchers, while infantry conducted localized counterattacks and withdrew to the next defensive position under pressure. In the Bekaa air campaign, Israel used E-2C aircraft, radar jammers, AGM-45 anti-radiation missiles, and coordinated attacks against SA-2 and SA-3 batteries. Radars and launch positions were weakened before strike aircraft entered at low altitude. Syrian fighters initially remained dispersed on the ground and resumed operations after jamming and air-defence pressure declined. Outside Beirut, Israeli forces blocked the principal roads and reduced outer positions separately rather than immediately attempting a general ground assault on the entire city. Blockade, artillery, air attack, and negotiation then combined to induce the PLO leadership to withdraw.
data: 六月六日約四時，以色列炮火與空襲展開，戰爭由邊界滲透事件轉為全面地面進攻。首週內，第八裝甲師沿沿海走廊推進並控制西頓、泰爾一帶；中部部隊在利塔尼河及哈斯巴亞方向遭遇較強抵抗。六月十日前後，多數作戰部隊已在利塔尼河一線建立廣闊控制區，縱深約四十公里。六月十一日，美國總統雷根提出為期兩週的停火，以色列表示接受，PLO拒絕全部條件；六月十四日前後雖形成局部停火安排，雙方卻未建立可核查的同步停火。六月十五日，聯合國安全理事會通過第502號決議，譴責以色列的軍事行動並要求停火及撤軍。六月二十一日至二十二日，以軍把空戰擴至貝卡谷地，打擊敘利亞地空飛彈網；同日開始的木牆行動則集中清除利塔尼河以南的PLO指揮、火箭炮與後勤節點。六月底至七月初，南北兩翼在貝魯特通往達穆爾的走廊會合，對西貝魯特的封鎖逐漸固定。七月五日，以色列空軍戰史記錄F-15編隊在貝卡擊落四架敘利亞米格-15戰機；敘利亞航空兵力此後更依賴疏散、轉場與地面待命。七月的主要戰事轉為封鎖、砲火與談判並行；八月一日，以色列空襲貝魯特的PLO總部建築，該組織隨後加快撤離安排。八月十日，以方宣布解除封鎖並接受撤離安排；PLO主力車隊於八月十一日開始離開貝魯特，最後一批有組織部隊在十二日完成轉移，取道敘利亞控制區及約旦方向前往突尼斯。九月十八日，以色列與黎巴嫩簽署後續協議，確定撤軍與南部安全區安排。各方傷亡總數因起訖日期、戰俘及後續衝突是否納入而不同，本錄不填入無法交叉核實的精確總數。
dataEn: At about 04:00 on 6 June, Israeli artillery and air attacks opened the campaign, turning an incident at the frontier into a full-scale ground invasion. During the first week, the Eighth Armored Division advanced along the coastal corridor and took control around Sidon and Tyre, while central formations encountered stronger resistance near the Litani and Hasbaya. By about 10 June, most field units had established control along a broad front at the Litani, roughly forty kilometres deep. On 11 June, US president Ronald Reagan proposed a two-week ceasefire. Israel accepted the proposal, while the PLO rejected its full terms. A limited arrangement formed around 14 June, but no mutually verifiable simultaneous halt was established. On 15 June, the UN Security Council adopted Resolution 502, condemning the Israeli military action and calling for a ceasefire and withdrawal. Between 21 and 22 June, Israel extended the air campaign into the Bekaa and attacked the Syrian surface-to-air missile network. Wooden Wall, begun on 22 June, concentrated on PLO command, rocket artillery, and logistics south of the Litani. From late June into early July, northern and southern forces linked along the Beirut-Damour corridor, and the encirclement of West Beirut gradually became fixed. On 5 July, Israeli air-force records credited an F-15 formation in the Bekaa with the destruction of four Syrian MiG-15 fighters. Syrian air units increasingly relied thereafter on dispersal, relocation, and ground holding. During July, blockade, artillery, and negotiation became the principal means of applying pressure. On 1 August, Israeli aircraft struck the PLO headquarters building in Beirut, accelerating the evacuation negotiations. On 10 August, Israel lifted the blockade after an evacuation arrangement was accepted. The main PLO convoy began leaving Beirut on 11 August, and the last organized formations completed their transfer on 12 August through Syrian-held territory and the Jordan direction before continuing to Tunis. On 18 September, Israel and Lebanon signed an agreement governing withdrawal and the security zone in the south. Casualty totals vary with the dates used and with the inclusion of prisoners or later clashes, so this record does not insert an exact total that cannot be cross-checked.
cause: 直接背景是1981年利塔尼河停火線及其執行爭議。以色列把PLO在黎巴嫩南部重新部署兵員、火箭炮和固定工事視為違反既有安排，並認為邊境滲透與跨境射擊已形成軍事威脅；PLO則把任何以色列駐軍與黎巴嫩主權問題相連，否認以色列所稱的滲透事件。兩種敘述在六月初泰爾附近的武裝衝突中完全相反，PLO指責以色列先採取軍事行動，以色列則把衝突視為全面清除南部PLO基地的理由。聯合國安全理事會第501號決議是在全面越境作戰前，要求各方保持克制，但它沒有消除以色列政府已作出的政治決定。六月五日，以色列先以有限空襲和地面行動打擊PLO；六月六日，軍隊越過利塔尼河，正式進入黎巴嫩。公開目標主要是把PLO重新推到利塔尼河以北，但以軍預案、師級裝甲部署與後續補給安排都指向更深的縱深，包括摧毀PLO指揮體系、火箭炮與南北聯絡，並打通通往貝魯特的走廊。PLO不能放棄其在黎巴嫩的基地，敘利亞則以防空力量支援；六月停火之所以失敗，關鍵正是雙方條件不相容，以色列要求PLO撤出貝魯特，PLO要求以色列撤出黎巴嫩，而當時雙方都沒有接受對方提出的整體交換。
causeEn: The immediate background was the Litani ceasefire line of 1981 and disagreement over its implementation. Israel regarded the renewed PLO deployment of troops, rocket artillery, and permanent fortifications in southern Lebanon as a breach of the existing arrangement and considered border infiltration and cross-border fire to be a military threat. The PLO linked Israeli troop presence to Lebanese sovereignty and denied the infiltration incidents alleged by Israel. The competing accounts collided in an armed clash near Tyre in early June. The PLO accused Israel of initiating military action, while Israel treated the clash as grounds for removing the PLO military presence from the south. UN Security Council Resolution 501 called for restraint before the full cross-border operation, but it did not reverse the political decision already taken by the Israeli government. On 5 June, Israel began limited air and ground attacks against PLO targets. On 6 June, its forces crossed the Litani and entered Lebanon. The publicly stated principal objective was to return the PLO north of the Litani, but Israeli operational plans, divisional armored deployments, and supporting logistics extended farther inland. They called for the destruction of PLO command, rocket artillery, and north-south communications while opening a corridor toward Beirut. The PLO could not simply abandon its Lebanese base, and Syria supported it through its air-defence forces. The June ceasefire failed because the proposed exchanges were incompatible: Israel required PLO withdrawal from Beirut, the PLO demanded Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon, and neither side accepted the other's full terms.
impact: 軍事上，以色列在黎巴嫩南部建立了比1981年更深的控制區，並在貝卡空戰中使敘利亞的SA-2與SA-3雷達、發射陣地和指揮流程一度失去整體效能。敘利亞戰機因此長時間採分散、掩蔽與短程出擊方式，殘存防空系統其後重建；以軍則取得貝卡上空的階段性主動權。這種戰果並不等於敘利亞航空力量永久消失，因為地面防空、未受損建築與後備飛機仍能支持恢復。PLO失去南黎巴嫩的主要營區、火箭炮部署與通往貝卡的完整補給網，貝魯特總部受襲後，其政治和軍事指揮中心轉往突尼斯並在境外重組，但組織本身沒有被摧毀。黎巴嫩國家層面承受更直接的制度損失：軍隊指揮分裂，與PLO合作的部隊與維持中立的單位互不統一，南方黎巴嫩軍在1984年被解散，一部分人員被納入其他武裝。這使中央政府重新控制貝卡與舒夫的努力延後。以色列則獲得安全區、海空通道與對邊境突發事件的預警時間。戰役也顯示，装甲、工兵、空軍、砲兵和後勤若不能保持同步，装甲優勢會迅速下降；反過來，縱深補給線與戰場情報同樣會限制進攻方。各方傷亡數字存在統計口徑差異，無法核實的精確總數不應被當作本戰唯一結論。
impactEn: Militarily, Israel established a deeper zone of control in southern Lebanon than it had held in 1981. In the Bekaa campaign, the operational cohesion of Syrian SA-2 and SA-3 radars, launch positions, and command flows was severely disrupted. Syrian aircraft consequently relied for extended periods on dispersal, concealment, and short sorties, while surviving air-defence elements were rebuilt later. Israel gained temporary control of the Bekaa skies, but this did not mean that Syrian air power disappeared permanently, because ground defences, undamaged structures, and reserve aircraft supported recovery. The PLO lost its principal camps in southern Lebanon, its rocket-artillery deployment, and its intact supply network into the Bekaa. After its Beirut headquarters was struck, its political and military center moved to Tunis and was rebuilt outside Lebanon, but the organization itself survived. The Lebanese state suffered a more direct institutional loss. Command within the army fragmented, units cooperating with the PLO and units remaining neutral were not integrated, and the South Lebanon Army was dissolved in 1984, with some of its personnel entering other armed formations. This delayed efforts by the central government to redeploy in the Bekaa and Chouf. Israel, in turn, obtained a security zone, reliable air and sea approaches, and additional warning time along the frontier. The campaign also showed that armored advantages declined rapidly unless armor, engineers, air power, artillery, and logistics remained synchronized. In the opposite direction, long supply routes and battlefield intelligence constrained the attacker. Casualty figures differed according to national counting rules, and exact totals that cannot be verified should not be presented as a single authoritative conclusion.
result: 就作戰結果而言，PLO有組織的地面部隊在八月十二日前後完成撤出貝魯特，亞西爾·阿拉法特及主要指揮機構轉往突尼斯；以色列則控制利塔尼河至北部邊界之間的安全區，並暫時掌握西貝魯特外圍與部分舒夫地區。九月十八日簽署的以色列—黎巴嫩協議處理以軍撤出貝魯特及南部防衛安排，規定上的主權歸屬與實際軍事控制因而並存。以色列在1984年撤出貝魯特，黎巴嫩軍重新進入舒夫與中部據點，南方黎巴嫩軍則正式解散；以色列安全區一直維持到1985年才撤除。PLO並未因離開黎巴嫩而消失，而是在突尼斯重建指揮與後續政治軍事活動，並於1980年代後期重返黎巴嫩。敘利亞仍保留在黎巴嫩的軍事存在，也重新部署防空系統。因此，這是一場以軍在黎巴嫩境內取得明確軍事控制、PLO失去黎巴嫩基地的戰役，但沒有形成永久解決黎巴嫩權力與安全問題的安排。日期上，本戰通常以六月六日至八月十日計；八月十一至十二日是PLO撤離完成，九月十八日則是後續雙邊協議日期，三者不應混為同一終點。
resultEn: In operational terms, the PLO completed the withdrawal of its organized ground formations from Beirut around 12 August. Yasser Arafat and the principal command institutions moved to Tunis, while Israel secured the security zone between the Litani and the northern frontier and temporarily held positions outside West Beirut and in parts of the Chouf. The Israeli-Lebanese agreement signed on 18 September addressed Israeli withdrawal from Beirut and the defence arrangements for southern Lebanon, leaving formal sovereignty and actual military control existing side by side. Israel withdrew from Beirut in 1984, the Lebanese army redeployed in the Chouf and central positions, and the South Lebanon Army was formally dissolved. The Israeli security zone remained until it was removed in 1985. The PLO did not disappear after leaving Lebanon. It rebuilt its command and political-military activity in Tunis, later returned to Lebanon in the late 1980s, and Syria maintained a military presence while rebuilding its air-defence system. The result was therefore a campaign in which Israel obtained clear military control inside Lebanon and the PLO lost its Lebanese base, but not a permanent settlement of Lebanon's political and security problems. The war is conventionally dated from 6 June to 10 August. The evacuation occurred on 11 and 12 August, while the subsequent bilateral agreement was signed on 18 September; these are distinct terminal dates and should not be treated as one.
